subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should WhatsApp unknown-group departure be keyed only to the documented `channels.whatsapp.groups` admission map, and should owner notification plus manual leave ship in the same policy contract?
rationale: The requested operation changes external membership, while the issue’s example conflates group admission with sender authorization; source evidence establishes feasibility but cannot choose the permanent security and notification policy.

options.title: Unified group-map policy
options.body: Use `channels.whatsapp.groups` as the sole unknown-group signal, add opt-in ignore, notify, and leave outcomes, and authorize manual leave with a group-specific account-and-target check.

options.title: Notification only
options.body: Emit a sanitized owner notification for newly observed unconfigured groups but keep departure outside OpenClaw.

options.title: Keep filtering only
options.body: Retain current traffic denial and document manual WhatsApp group removal as the supported membership-control path.

recommendation.title: Unified group-map policy
recommendation.body: Use `channels.whatsapp.groups` as the sole unknown-group signal, add opt-in ignore, notify, and leave outcomes, and authorize manual leave with a group-specific account-and-target check.
